yeah i dont even know. its nothing really. probably just me being dramatic

hard to pin down i guess. like theres this thing with one of my friends and i cant tell if im overreacting. shes going thru a lot and i keep dropping everything for her but i just feel so tired

idk maybe. its more like... shes texting me at like 1am every night having a crisis and i answer every time bc what kind of friend wouldnt. but ive got my own stuff and im stretched so thin i feel like im gonna snap. but then i feel guilty for even thinking that
That 1am pattern sounds like it keeps pulling you past where you have room, and then the guilt shows up right after. It’s a lot to hold at once.
yeah. like i love her i do. but i dont remember the last time she asked how i was doing. and i hate that i even notice that bc shes hurting and im supposed to be the strong one. ugh i dont know

yeah maybe lets leave it there. i dont really know what to do with all that anyway. but it helped a little to say it out loud i think. thanks
